item.title: [threat-intel] FBI links Signal phishing attacks to Russian intelligence services
item.description: The FBI has issued a public service announcement warning that Russian intelligence-linked threat actors are actively targeting users of encrypted messaging apps such as Signal and WhatsApp in phishing campaigns that have already compromised thousands of accounts. [...]

item.title: [threat-intel] Russia-linked actors target WhatsApp and Signal in phishing campaign
item.description: Russia-linked actors target WhatsApp and Signal accounts of officials and journalists via phishing, gaining access to messages and contacts. Threat actors linked to Russian Intelligence Services are running phishing campaigns to hijack high-value accounts on messaging apps like WhatsApp and Signal, the FBI warns. &#8220;The FBI has identified cyber actors associated with Russian Intelligence Services targeting [&#8230;]
